policy: Aggregate indicators only. These do not count individual property sales and are never converted into sale counts.

indicators.label: Formal home-loan stock
indicators.interpretation: This is the outstanding balance of individual housing loans across HFCs, public-sector banks, private-sector banks and RRBs—not the number of loans and not property sales. It increased 0.94% from May 2026 and 9.42% from June 2025. Rising outstanding balance indicates expanding formal housing finance, but may reflect new lending, drawdowns, repayment timing and balance growth.

indicators.label: Bank housing credit
indicators.source: RBI Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit
indicators.interpretation: The RBI publishes a housing-credit line in its sectoral tables. The current table file is not machine-readable in this collector, so no housing-only number is displayed. Broad personal-loan growth is deliberately excluded.

indicators.label: Bengaluru housing index
indicators.interpretation: NHB publishes a quarterly Bengaluru index and under-construction market index. The numeric city series is kept separate from sales and credit.

indicators.label: Lender disbursement pulse
indicators.interpretation: A cross-check for financing demand; lender coverage is partial and not Bengaluru-specific.

next: The first two indicators are now integrated as validated aggregate context. RESIDEX is linked and monitored; its city series will be added only after stable table extraction.
